models.name: econ_political_discussion_articles
models.description:
Core discussion articles for economic and political topics.

Stores user-generated discussion posts focused on economic policies, political developments, market analysis, and related topics. Each article represents a primary discussion thread that users can create, edit, and engage with independently.

Articles support rich content including title, detailed content, and optional category classification for economic/political topics. The system maintains full temporal tracking and supports soft deletion for content management.

Each article links to a user author and can have multiple file attachments through the established relationship with the attachment system.

foreignFields.name: econ_political_discussion_user_id
foreignFields.description: Author who created this article discussion. {@link econ_political_discussion_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title for the discussion post. Descriptive topic heading.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Full article content for the economic/political discussion. Rich text content body.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Topic category for economic/political classification (e.g., 'Economic Policy', 'Political Analysis', 'Market Discussion').

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Article publication status. Default 'published' for active discussions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this discussion article was originally created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this discussion article was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for archived or removed discussions.

models.name: econ_political_discussion_users
models.description:
Simple user profiles for discussion board participants.

Provides basic user identification and profile management for discussion participants. Maintains minimal user concepts as requested for the simple economic and political discussion board.

Users can create articles, build discussion profiles, and maintain basic account information. The design focuses on simple author identification rather than complex user management systems.

Supports standard profile fields including display name and optional bio, with complete temporal tracking for account lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name for article authorship and community identification.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address for account management and notifications.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Optional user biography describing interests or background in economics/politics.

plainFields.name: avatar_url
plainFields.description: Optional profile picture URL for user identification in discussions.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: User account status (active, suspended, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this user account was originally created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this user profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for deactivated user accounts.

models.name: econ_political_discussion_attachments
models.description:
File and image attachments for economic and political discussion articles.

Stores uploaded files and images that users attach to their discussion posts, supporting rich media content in economic and political discourse. Each attachment includes comprehensive metadata for file management, security scanning, and content moderation.

Supports multiple file types including images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP up to 5MB) and documents (PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT up to 10MB). Files are associated with specific discussion articles and include security scanning status and access controls.

The table maintains file metadata including original filename, MIME type, file size, and storage URL. All attachments are subject to content moderation and security scanning before becoming publicly accessible.

Attachments remain associated with articles even if original content is modified, providing historical context and supporting comprehensive discussion threads with multimedia content.

foreignFields.name: econ_political_discussion_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the discussion article this attachment belongs to. {@link econ_political_discussion_articles.id}.

plainFields.name: original_filename
plainFields.description: Original filename as uploaded by the user.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type or file extension indicating the type of file (e.g., 'image/jpeg', 'application/pdf').

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes for storage and bandwidth management.

plainFields.name: file_url
plainFields.description: URL or path where the file is stored in the cloud storage system.

plainFields.name: upload_date
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded to the system.

plainFields.name: uploader_name
plainFields.description: Name of the user who uploaded the file for attribution and contact purposes.

plainFields.name: security_scan_status
plainFields.description: Status of security scanning: 'pending', 'clean', 'flagged', or 'quarantined'.

plainFields.name: moderation_status
plainFields.description: Content moderation status: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', or 'requires_review'.

plainFields.name: is_public
plainFields.description: Whether this file is publicly accessible or restricted to authorized users only.
